hypotheses.cost: one-way 2 bps research cost; no leverage
hypotheses.dataset: Frozen GLBX curve OI plus CFTC GOLD/OIL weekly series. No new Databento bytes.
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Daily official open interest flow plus weekly positioning change in the same direction is a position build, a speed-aligned crowding transition, not a COT extreme. Not price momentum.
hypotheses.failure_gate: If FALSIFIED, do not retune OI or weekly positioning sign. Next = EIA wow x CL curve.
hypotheses.feature: week-sum official front_oi_change > 0 and weekly mm_net change > 0, after Friday 21:00Z
hypotheses.hypothesis: When official daily open interest flow and weekly positioning both rise in the same census week, a build is confirmed after Friday knowledge. Next-session front return is negative.
hypotheses.name: BUILD_ALIGN
hypotheses.target: next-session front open-to-open after Friday knowledge_time
hypotheses.validation: pre-registered; leakage; knowledge-time; determinism; lineage; FDR q=0.05; four Xavier

hypotheses.dataset: same frozen official OI plus weekly positioning
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Daily official open interest flow up against a weekly positioning unwind is a speed gap between the exchange clock and the census clock, not a COT extreme. Not price momentum.
hypotheses.failure_gate: No hold search. Do not replace weekly positioning with a COT extreme as a rescue.
hypotheses.feature: week-sum official front_oi_change > 0 and weekly mm_net change < 0
hypotheses.hypothesis: When official daily open interest expands while weekly positioning falls, exchange participation and the delayed census disagree. After Friday knowledge, next-session front return is positive.
hypotheses.name: SPEED_GAP
hypotheses.target: next-session front open-to-open after Friday knowledge_time
hypotheses.validation: same gates; not a z score search

hypotheses.dataset: same frozen official OI plus weekly positioning
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Daily official open interest flow down plus weekly positioning unwind is a confirmed position unwinding, not a COT extreme. Not price momentum.
hypotheses.failure_gate: If failed, do not reopen POSITIONING_V1 extremes.
hypotheses.feature: week-sum official front_oi_change < 0 and weekly mm_net change < 0
hypotheses.hypothesis: When official daily open interest and weekly positioning both fall, an unwind is confirmed after Friday knowledge. Next-session front return is positive.
hypotheses.name: UNWIND_ALIGN
hypotheses.target: next-session front open-to-open after Friday knowledge_time
